title.zh: 韩国银行推出首批比特币抵押贷款
title.en: South Korean bank launches first Bitcoin-backed loans

current_state.zh: South Korea saw its first loans from traditional banks backed by bitcoin as collateral, extending crypto into mainstream bank credit in a major regulated market.
current_state.en: South Korea saw its first loans from traditional banks backed by bitcoin as collateral, extending crypto into mainstream bank credit in a major regulated market.

updates.title_zh: 韩国刚刚出现首批由比特币作为抵押的传统银行贷款
updates.title_en: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 CoinDesk 报道，韩国一家传统银行已发放以比特币作为抵押品的贷款，这是该国首次由传统银行提供此类贷款。此举标志着比特币在亚洲主要市场的主流银行渠道中被接受为贷款抵押品。

这一进展表明，愿意将比特币视为可接受贷款抵押品的不再只是加密原生借贷机构，还包括受监管的银行。信源将其描述为加密资产作为抵押品在亚洲主要市场获得机构采用的新一步。

这些贷款被描述为韩国传统银行的首例，从而与以往由专业数字资产借贷机构提供的加密抵押贷款区分开来。
updates.what_changed_en: South Korea's Jeonbuk Bank has reportedly begun offering Bitcoin-backed won-denominated loans to corporate customers, using a third-party custodian and relying on amended Civil Enforcement Rules that allow courts to seize and liquidate crypto collateral in case of default.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: South Korea's Jeonbuk Bank has reportedly begun offering Bitcoin-backed won-denominated loans to corporate customers, using a third-party custodian and relying on amended Civil Enforcement Rules that allow courts to seize and liquidate crypto collateral in case of default.
updates.detailed_summary_en: South Korea's Jeonbuk Bank has reportedly begun offering Bitcoin-backed won-denominated loans to corporate customers, using a third-party custodian and relying on amended Civil Enforcement Rules that allow courts to seize and liquidate crypto collateral in case of default.
updates.background_zh: 韩国拥有全球最活跃的零售加密市场之一，但银行以数字资产为抵押发放贷款的情况一直较为罕见。加密抵押借贷是指以比特币、以太坊等数字货币作为质押，获取法币或稳定币计价的贷款，其结构类似以房地产或股票等传统资产为抵押的借贷。这类业务此前主要由加密原生平台而非受监管银行提供。
updates.background_en: South Korea is home to one of the world's most active retail crypto markets, but bank lending against digital assets has been rare. Crypto-collateralized lending involves pledging digital currencies such as bitcoin or ether to obtain loans denominated in fiat currency or stablecoins, structurally similar to traditional asset-backed lending that uses real estate or equities as collateral. That activity has mostly been provided by crypto-native platforms rather than regulated banks.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于信贷与抵押品：若比特币可在韩国受监管银行用作抵押品，便将 BTC 持有者的资产负债表与韩国银行体系连接起来，可能影响韩国境内比特币托管与结算的需求，并透过套利资金在边际上影响本地价格相对离岸市场的价差。相关敞口集中于比特币以及韩国的银行与托管渠道，而非扩散至整个市场。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is credit and collateral: if bitcoin becomes usable as collateral at regulated Korean banks, it links BTC holders' balance sheets to the domestic banking system, which can affect demand for bitcoin custody and settlement in Korea and, at the margin, the local price spread versus offshore venues through arbitrage flows. The exposure is concentrated in bitcoin and in Korean banking and custody channels rather than spread across the broader market.
